remarks: This immaculate third-floor unit offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience. Recently updated throughout, you enter into a versatile entryway that can serve as a home office, flowing seamlessly into a spacious and bright living room. Just steps away, the dining area features modern lighting and ample space for entertaining. The bright kitchen is filled with natural light and offers easy access from the dining area, creating a functional and inviting layout. The generously sized sleeping area is thoughtfully situated for added privacy and provides a peaceful retreat from the main living space. Abundant closet and storage space can be found throughout the unit, while the full bathroom has been tastefully updated with modern finishes. Located within walking distance of downtown restaurants, shops, and nightlife, this unit offers both convenience and charm. The beautifully maintained grounds feature a picturesque courtyard, lush gardens, and ample parking. This move-in-ready unit truly has it all
